children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may retest a support at $7.56 per bushel, a break below which could open the way toward the $7.34-3/4 to $7.43-1/2 range.
A five-wave cycle from $6.85 may have completed. The bottom of the wave 4 at $7.43-1/2 serves as a target. Three small waves make up the current correction.
The wave c is travelling toward $7.56. Immediate resistance is at $7.80, a break above which could trigger a gain into $7.90-1/4 to $7.98-1/4 range.

On the daily chart, the uptrend remains intact, as it is riding on a wave C which has travelled above $7.51-3/4, its 100% projection level. This wave is likely to extend to the 138.2% level of $8.13-1/2.
However, a hanging man formed on Monday, marking the start of a correction. The uptrend is expected to resume upon the completion of the correction.
